# e2e/genmatrix.py turns this file into the workflow matrix, so adding a
# protocol is a one-line change HERE and nothing else.
# The driver is chosen from what the script ACTUALLY invokes (verified by

# reading each e2e/scripts/

.sh), not from the protocol's name.

# toolchain: several of the obvious images do not exist under those names, and

# (EACCES on save_state). One Debian base keeps the runner happy.

column1: # --- protocols that need their own distro/toolchain image ---
# These five were previously parked here with "environmental" excuses. They are
# back in the matrix: each one only needed the RIGHT image, not a workaround.
#   oci       ubuntu:24.04 + wget/tar speaks /v2 itself (no docker/dockerd).
#   luarocks  needs the luarocks CLI, which alpine has as a package.
#   nix       needs a real Nix install; the official installer refuses without
#             sudo, so use an image that SHIPS nix (see the nix-driver notes).
#   gitlfs    needs the git-lfs binary; the adapter serves LFS objects, and the
#             suite is adapted to that protocol (no full clone required).
#   swift     needs a Swift toolchain; the official swift image has swiftc.

column3: script speaks the /v2 protocol with wget (needs EASYBLOBS_URL)
official Nix tarball unpacked in the job (nixos/nix breaks Actions)
script drives the LFS object protocol with git + git-lfs
